messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you miss your bedtime dose, take your next dose at the regular time the following evening"
set: ["if you miss your bedtime dose, take your next dose at the regular time the following evening", "take your next dose at the regular time", "skip the missed dose and take next dose at regular time", "use next dose at regular time", "If it is almost time for your next dose, skip the one you missed", "take next dose at usual time", "If it is almost time for your next dose, wait until then to take the medicine", "take next dose at normal scheduled time", "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule", "skip the missed dose if it is almost time for your next dose", "take your dose in the morning if your doctor tells you to", "next dose should be taken the following day", "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets", "if you break a scored tablet and take only half, take the other half at your next dose", "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose", "take in either the morning or the evening"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take your next dose at the regular time",
    "skip the missed dose and take next dose at regular time",
    "use next dose at regular time",
    "take next dose at usual time",
    "take next dose at normal scheduled time",
    "take next dose at regular time and stay on twice-daily schedule",
    "skip the missed dose if it is almost time for your next dose",
    "skip it if it is almost time for your next dose",
    "next dose should be taken the following day",
    "do not take the missed dose if you miss a dose of the tablets"
  ],
  "alias": "take next dose at regular time"
}
